evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、src/auto-inject.js、src/doc-pipeline.js、src/index.js、src/insight-store.js、src/recall.js、src/setup/taskbridge.js、src/skill.js、src/store.js、src/tools/query-memory.js、src/tools/remember.js、src/util/fs.js；根解析、TaskBridge、分层召回与pre-step提示接线；task绑定不隔离global。见[Q02](#research-q02)。
limitations: 核固定README/package、入口注册、根解析、任务绑定/路径、可见性、文档索引、查询返回、自动注入及保存调用链；未穷举解析器、UI编辑路由、所有工具或外部依赖实现。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 同一代码项目跨会话续接，价值应按正确完成任务而非条目数量衡量。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
根解析、TaskBridge、分层召回与pre-step提示接线；task绑定不隔离global。见[Q02](#research-q02)。
核固定README/package、入口注册、根解析、任务绑定/路径、可见性、文档索引、查询返回、自动注入及保存调用链；未穷举解析器、UI编辑路由、所有工具或外部依赖实现。
固定源码package0.6.7，main=src/index.js，Node>=18与宿主范围按包声明；未核npm制品对应或目标加载。
索引无LLM不代表总使用零成本；回源与dirty恢复需计入每次合格续接。完整表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
单项目保留笔记基线，先按需再自动；先解释持久状态后扩大范围。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
可考察重新定位步骤减少，当前不能声称更少错误/更省token。保留和否定条件见[Q06](#research-q06)。
根护栏、任务绑定、召回层与持久重试可借鉴；多层状态需向使用者给出一致含义。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
把任务、文件索引与经验召回连为跨会话开发辅助流程，减少重新定位的潜在步骤。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
exact是占位，Saved不证明已落盘；相关性和作用域也不能保证经验仍正确。见[Q03](#research-q03)。
让接受/待持久化/读回确认与陈旧来源状态可见，能否减少误信及总恢复成本须对照。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
核心需要宿主工具/事件与可写项目存储；PDF为直接依赖，向量、LLM扩展及指南/UI入口有条件。详表见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)任务/分层召回/事件结合超单索引接线25%，novelty50%；未见通用新检索原理不进75%。根/范围/dirty恢复有机制组合，mechanism50%高于单包装，持久回执与陈旧状态[Q03](#research-q03)未闭环不进75%。分层与根护栏可迁移，transferability50%超过DOM专用25%，未验证跨宿主75%。索引简化重读但增加多层状态，simplification25%未达净简化50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)从手工笔记转任务关联续接workflow50%高于局部查询25%，未证端到端流程改变75%。[Q02](#research-q02)持久任务与来源交付delivery50%超显示入口25%，不等于可靠业务结果75%。面板/指南降低接入门槛reach25%，无新用户层证据不进50%。[Q05](#research-q05)没有已识别经济结构变化economics0%，资源与人工未知并不自动算节省。

recommendation.reason: 经常跨会话恢复同一项目任务的开发者，可先在非敏感单项目按需召回并回源核对。相比笔记与grep，源码连好了任务、文件和经验提示，但尚无正确续接与总成本对照。如果跨项目误用、来源过期或Saved后持久状态无法解释，应停用注入并保留两层存储回到原流程。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)跨会话清单/文件定位是具体重复摩擦，任务续接接线支撑75%高于仅可想象50%；缺真实用户任务结果不进100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)任务绑定、多层回源和主动提示超手记入口25%；[Q03](#research-q03)陈旧/回执边界仍关键，50%不进已证明显著优势75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)核入口/根/任务/召回到[Q03](#research-q03)保存与失败分支，超过局部声明25%；无宿主/故障实测，源码50%上限不进75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)有关闭/备份恢复路径，非无从试用0%；[Q03](#research-q03)global与持久回执、[Q05](#research-q05)资源及纠错负担未明，25%不足主要成本可控50%。

# dsh-project-memory > 关联跨会话任务、项目文件和经验记忆，提供分层召回与自动上下文提示。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[00080000/dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory) - **版本号**：0.6.7（[固定提交 27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/tree/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-28（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持续接、召回和恢复设计；正确性/净成本及锁忙回执缺实测，明确状态回执是待验证方向。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：同一代码项目跨会话续接，价值应按正确完成任务而非条目数量衡量。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：把任务、文件索引与经验召回连为跨会话开发辅助流程，减少重新定位的潜在步骤。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **思考**：exact是占位，Saved不证明已落盘；相关性和作用域也不能保证经验仍正确。见[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：让接受/待持久化/读回确认与陈旧来源状态可见，能否减少误信及总恢复成本须对照。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 采用建议：单项目保留笔记基线，先按需再自动；先解释持久状态后扩大范围。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 ## 核心贡献 把任务、文件索引与经验召回连为跨会话开发辅助流程，减少重新定位的潜在步骤。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 关键质疑 exact是占位，Saved不证明已落盘；相关性和作用域也不能保证经验仍正确。见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 让接受/待持久化/读回确认与陈旧来源状态可见，能否减少误信及总恢复成本须对照。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 未运行目标；一般宿主安装归范围边界，锁忙回执、陈旧误用和实际成本是待研究问题。 ## 场景与替代办法 同一代码项目跨会话续接，价值应按正确完成任务而非条目数量衡量。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 任务笔记/AGENTS.md与grep更轻；插件增加自动关联和主动提示，也增加状态维护与核验。 ## 依赖与流程 核心需要宿主工具/事件与可写项目存储；PDF为直接依赖，向量、LLM扩展及指南/UI入口有条件。详表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 先核root和按需查询，再验任务续接、默认注入与保存重开；不要只凭Saved判断成功。步骤见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 成本与效果 索引无LLM不代表总使用零成本；回源与dirty恢复需计入每次合格续接。完整表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 可考察重新定位步骤减少，当前不能声称更少错误/更省token。保留和否定条件见[Q06](#research-q06)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：项目记忆能否正确续接并回源，提示/成功回执怎样避免陈旧与未落盘误判？ ### Q01 · 项目记忆对谁增加了什么交付价值？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 适合同一代码项目反复跨会话开发、容易丢失任务步骤和相关文件位置的 DSH 用户。作者把任务续接、文档/符号索引和经验记忆组合起来。合格结果是新会话找到正确任务与当前文件，继续完成工作并能回源核对，不是磁盘条目更多或召回分数更高。 手工任务笔记、AGENTS.md 与 grep 是较轻基线：记录清单并搜索现有代码。插件增加会话到持久任务的绑定、文件关联、多层召回和可选自动提示，可能减少重新定位；代价是维护第二份状态及确认记忆是否还适用。源码证实组件已接线，作者声称减少重复调试和上下文丢失，但未独立验证节时或正确率。偶尔单会话工作、笔记足够的人无须为索引和全局知识增加维护。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:10-22](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5/README.md#L10-L22) 作者项目开发记忆与跨会话任务定位。
查看原文（13行） ```text A persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Underneath sits a **hybrid index**: document chunks, code symbols, experience notes and insights each form a layer, scored per layer and merged into one ranking. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. Data survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification. > The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project. ![Task panel: task list, step progress, and involved files](docs/images/image.png) ## Features - **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-scoping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `select_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. On hosts without session events the task tools still work as a plain record list. - **Task panel and editing** — draggable cards show a task's steps and files, and can collapse to a mini-bar or be hidden. Title, steps and status can be edited inline, writing back through the same path as model updates; four visual themes change material, geometry, typeface and density only, and colours follow the host. The panel stays hidden until summoned, syncs in the background on session switch, never reopens itself after a refresh, and a render failure cannot take down the host. - **Document memory** — PDF, Markdown and plain text are chunked and summarized without a model call. Each entry keeps a short summary for injection, a bounded term set for recall, and a citation back to the source. - **Code symbol memory** — a dependency-free scanner extracts functions, classes, methods, interfaces and type aliases with signatures; covered languages are JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, C/C++/C#, Java and shell. Where `typescript` is installed, an optional second layer adds inferred return types, generics and interface shapes; it runs in the background and never blocks indexing. - **Automatic, read-time memorization** — with lazy indexing (default), a file is memorized the moment the model reads it, so memory grows as a byproduct of normal work rather than an upfront scan. `index_repo` or a watched root can cover the rest of the tree; a background poll only re-indexes files that changed. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.js:194-219](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5/src/index.js#L194-L219) 任务、索引、查询、经验工具与自动注入实际注册。
查看原文（26行） ```text ctx.tools.register(listTasksTool(config)) ctx.tools.register(selectTaskTool(config, { llm: ctx.llm, ctx })) ctx.tools.register(archiveTaskTool(config, { llm: ctx.llm, ctx })) ctx.tools.register(showTaskPanelTool(config)) // /tasks：唯一的用户命令（宿主命令注册后必然出现在 `/` 菜单且无法隐藏，所以只留一条）； // 切换/归档/审核等子动词由面板按钮经 remote.commands.execute 驱动。 try { ctx.inject(['commands'], (commandsCtx) => { commandsCtx.commands.register(workflowCommandDefinition(config, ctx)) }) } catch (err) { console.error(`[dsh-project-memory] /tasks registration skipped: ${err.message}`) } ctx.tools.register(indexDocTool(ctx, config)) ctx.tools.register(indexRepoTool(ctx, config)) ctx.tools.register(queryMemoryTool(ctx, config)) ctx.tools.register(rememberTool(config)) ctx.tools.register(forgetTool(config)) ctx.tools.register(lessonTool(config)) ctx.tools.register(watchRepoTool(watchManager, config)) ctx.tools.register(statsTool(config)) // 注册 agent/pre-step 监听，向每步请求追加记忆消息（默认开；异常/无会话 cwd → 交回默认决策）。 installAutoInject(ctx, config) ```
#### 缺口 - 跨会话任务对照缺失。 **影响**：不能把接口齐备推成节时或避免错误。 **进一步探讨**：固定项目任务，对照笔记/grep与插件，记录正确续接、回源与总人工耗时。 ### Q02 · 根、任务与召回怎样连成链路？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 工具先解析显式 root 或会话记忆根；显式根走安全校验，查询另检查根存在且非空查询，避免拼错目录被当空记忆。TaskBridge 把项目外路径丢弃，绑定任务可将已有步骤写回宿主 todo；子代理判定用 origin/delegationDepth，不把 fork 的 parentSession 一概当子代理。这里的根护栏是存储范围规则，不是多用户身份授权。 query_memory 从项目存储和 GlobalStore 取内容；任务级 insight 只对绑定任务可见，项目级和全局级均可召回，archived/draft 被过滤。可选 LLM 扩展在召回期发生；可选向量重排主要作用经验/insight，没安装时保留词法路径。文档/符号结果按层内相对分合并并保留层代表，返回 path:line；insight 的文件可缺，不能说每条记忆都有精确行号。 文档构建提取全文、分块、生成摘要/检索词并保存文本 hash，未把 LLM 传入索引构建。hash 用于索引更新，不提供经验事实真伪证明。路径和任务链接让用户知道去哪检查；它们不能替代重新读取当前文件。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/util/fs.js:1310-1321](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5/src/util/fs.js#L1310-L1321) 显式根安全校验、会话根与拒绝分支。
查看原文（12行） ```text export function resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, explicitRoot, config) { const allowUnsafe = config?.allowUnsafeRoots === true const explicit = explicitRoot && String(explicitRoot).trim() ? String(explicitRoot) : null if (explicit) { return assertSafeRoot(path.resolve(explicit), { requested: explicit, allowUnsafe, config }) } const cwd = resolveIndexRoot(exec) const root = resolveProjectMemoryRoot(cwd, config) if (root) return root // allowUnsafeRoots 只放开内置名单；cwd 被 deny / exclude / 文件系统根命中时仍然拒绝。 if (allowUnsafe && !rootRejection(cwd, config)) return cwd throw new UnsafeRootError(cwd, cwd, { config }) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/tools/query-memory.js:88-124](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5/src/tools/query-memory.js#L88-L124) 根/非空查询、存储、扩展和可选重排。
查看原文（37行） ```text async execute(args, exec) { const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config) // 读路径也要验根存在。这条不是洁癖：可选的向量层（leanvec）在空 store 上会建 // `/.dsh-project-memory/vectors.json`，于是传错一个 root（拼写错误/旧路径）就能 // 在任意可写位置造出目录和空 store，而回报是"No memory matches"——看起来像"这个项目 // 没有记忆"，用户不会意识到自己查错了地方。与 index_repo/watch_repo 同一道护栏。 assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root) // 空查询不是"全部"：recallItems 会过滤空串，rankEntriesStreaming 随即返回 // entries.slice(0, limit)（任意条目、分数 0），task 分支的 includes('') 更是命中所有任务。 if (!String(args.query ?? ### Q03 · 注入与成功回执是否足够证明可信、持久？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 不足。自动上下文默认开，pre-step 先取得宿主 enter 决策，无会话 cwd/id 或不安全根即跳过；异常记录后返回原决策。候选分 authored trigger 全文和统计相关性提示两通道，有预算与冷却。触发条件、词法/向量分数只判断可能适用，不能验证旧经验与当前代码一致；消息生产者元数据也不直接进入模型序列化内容，标题是模型可见线索。默认提示不等于已经经过人工确认。 全局内容不随项目切换隔离；任务绑定只限制 task 层。query_memory 文档/符号输出的 status 在源码注明是占位，缺状态默认 exact，因此不能把这个词当成已实现陈旧检测的验收结论。可选向量自动合并会覆盖既有字段，虽有 previous 机制，语义近似也不能保证两个项目的解决办法相同。 持久化有目录锁、冲突合并和脏存储重试。锁超时 save() 返回 false，保持 dirty 并计划重试；但 commit() 忽略 save() 布尔值返回变更结果，remember 随后仅按 result.ok 输出 Saved/Updated。静态调用链因此允许“内存更新已成功、磁盘仍待写”用同一成功文案呈现；不是本轮已复现数据丢失。普通写异常仍会抛出，不能泛称所有失败均静默。卸载限时 flush 是恢复机会，不覆盖强制退出、断电或重试最终失败。 使用时把记忆当有来源的建议，确认根/作用域、回读当前文件；重要经验除看 Saved 外，应检查持久状态并在重开后复查。遇不明成功状态先保留存储、核锁/磁盘和重开读回，避免继续依赖尚未落盘的知识。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/index.js:94-107](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/blob/27398b5b7834319f2660540fa165cacbe3262ed5/src/index.js#L94-L107) 自动注入默认开。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-project-memory\n\n> If this plugin saves you an hour of debugging, a star would be appreciated.\n\n[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n[![ci](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/%40yolk_vat-y%2Fdsh-project-memory?style=flat-square&color=orange)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/00080000/dsh-project-memory) [![Awesome](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)\n\n\nA persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Underneath sits a **hybrid index**: document chunks, code symbols, experience notes and insights each form a layer, scored per layer and merged into one ranking. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. Data survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification.\n\n> The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project.\n\n![Task panel: task list, step progress, and involved files](docs/images/image.png)\n\n## Features\n\n- **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-scoping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `select_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. On hosts without session events the task tools still work as a plain record list.\n- **Task panel and editing** — draggable cards show a task's steps and files, and can collapse to a mini-bar or be hidden. Title, steps and status can be edited inline, writing back through the same path as model updates; four visual themes change material, geometry, typeface and density only, and colours follow the host. The panel stays hidden until summoned, syncs in the background on session switch, never reopens itself after a refresh, and a render failure cannot take down the host.\n- **Document memory** — PDF, Markdown and plain text are chunked and summarized without a model call. Each entry keeps a short summary for injection, a bounded term set for recall, and a citation back to the source.\n- **Code symbol memory** — a dependency-free scanner extracts functions, classes, methods, interfaces and type aliases with signatures; covered languages are JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, C/C++/C#, Java and shell. Where `typescript` is installed, an optional second layer adds inferred return types, generics and interface shapes; it runs in the background and never blocks indexing.\n- **Automatic, read-time memorization** — with lazy indexing (default), a file is memorized the moment the model reads it, so memory grows as a byproduct of normal work rather than an upfront scan. `index_repo` or a watched root can cover the rest of the tree; a background poll only re-indexes files that changed.\n- **Doc ↔ code cross-linking** — a document that mentions a symbol is surfaced when that symbol is queried. Links are resolved against the current symbol table, so they cannot go stale.\n- **Hybrid recall** — ranked search over documents, symbols, experience notes and insights, with optional LLM query expansion. The experience/insight layers are re-ordered by cosine when `leanvec` is present — installed by default, absent ⇒ pure lexical. Tuned for CJK: phrase boost, a synonym table, and CJK-aware boundaries for doc↔symbol linking.\n  Russian (Cyrillic) is supported too: word splitting, a stopword list and Snowball stemming, so Russian queries hit Russian notes and take part in dedup.\n- **Experience notes** — problems → solutions, deduplicated by overlap rather than repeated, bounded by project size, and surfaced both by search and by the same injection path as lessons.\n- **Tiered insight memory (lessons / decisions / procedures)** — one entity across task, project and global scope. Near-duplicates merge or reinforce, and promotion moves an entry between scopes instead of copying it. Use is recorded, so decay and capacity rank by activity rather than age alone. The panel exposes a per-scope view for reviewing and editing entries. That list is ordered newest-first and loaded incrementally: 30 entries at a time, with the next page prefetched before the reader reaches the bottom and off-screen rows skipped by the renderer, so a large memory stays responsive.\n- **Triggered injection** — an insight may carry an authored trigger: only `when` triggers, `guard` narrows it, and `prevents` records what breaks without the entry. Corpus text can never trigger an injection; the statistical channel is gated separately and silent by default. **Evidence is graded by source**: only host facts (structured tool calls, `fs`/`todo` events) and irreversible actions named by the human (commit / publish / release / push / deploy / go public) can inject full text; prose mentions of delete / clean up / render / benchmark only feed the hint channel, and subagent prompts plus notice-shaped messages never count as actions.\n- **Usage is a skill too** — it registers `project-memory` into the host `skills` registry (a directory bundle with `scripts/pm-digest.mjs`, `resourceBase` pointing inside the package). The model loads the query/write workflow on demand instead of carrying it in every prompt; hosts without a `skills` service skip it silently.\n\n## Installation\n\nThe plugin relies only on stable public APIs declared through peerDependencies.\n\n```bash\ncd dsh-project-memory && dsh plugin --profile web add . -w\n```\n\nThe `-w` (workspace-root) flag is required: the profile directory is a pnpm workspace root, and pnpm rejects `add` there without it. From elsewhere, use the same command with an absolute path.\n\nThe plugin is also published on npm as a scoped package:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add @yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory -w\n```\n\nEach indexed project has its own store at `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/`. It keeps itself out of git by default — there is nothing to add to your `.gitignore`. Global-scope entries are kept outside the project in `~/.config/dsh-project-memory/global.json`; point `insight.globalFile` elsewhere to move it.\n\n## Usage\n\nThe tools below are **invoked by the agent**, not typed by the user. In the chat, just ask naturally — e.g. \"index this project\" or \"what does the auth module do?\" — or simply keep working, and the agent calls the matching tool automatically. By default files are indexed the moment the model reads them, so memory fills in while you work. `watch_repo` keeps explicitly-watched roots fresh in the background; `index_repo` forces a full backfill (unchanged files are skipped).\n\nIn a git work tree the corpus is whatever `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` lists — tracked files plus untracked files that are not ignored — so `.gitignore`, nested rules included, decides what gets remembered. A directory that is not a git work tree falls back to a plain walk (no ignore rules). Lazy indexing applies the same check per file; an explicit `index_doc` bypasses `.gitignore`, but still respects `roots.exclude`, readability and the size limit, and its entry survives later scan passes for as long as the file exists.\n\n| Tool | Purpose |\n|---|---|\n| `index_doc file_path` | Index one document (PDF/MD/txt): chunk, summarize deterministically, and store with a `path:line` citation. Unchanged files are skipped. |\n| `index_repo root` | Index a whole project: documents get deterministic summaries, code files get a token-free symbol table. Incremental and self-healing: the store follows the file listing, so deleted, ignored or moved files are dropped (an entry created by an explicit `index_doc` is kept while its file still exists), and documents are cross-linked to symbols. A non-existent or excluded root is rejected before anything is written. |\n| `watch_repo root` | Enable automatic refresh: a background poll detects new and changed files and re-indexes only those. A watched root is recorded in that project's store, so it resumes when dsh starts there; a non-existent or excluded root is refused, roots that disappear are dropped rather than re-created. |\n| `memory_stats root` | Show what the store contains: totals, last index time, and the per-file list sorted by recency. |\n| `query_memory query` | Ranked search over documents, symbols, experience and insights, optionally query-expanded by the LLM. `type` selects a layer (`all` / `doc` / `symbol` / `experience` / `insight` / `task`). Returns hits with relative scores, sources or insight ids, and doc→symbol references. |\n| `list_tasks` | List task records for the project (archived marked). Call first in a new session before continuing work. |\n| `select_task` | Bind the session to a task so its todo list and file reads sync into it. Exact `taskId`, or exact `title` (multiple matches return candidates; no match creates a new task). Pass `title` with `taskId` to rename. Auto-unarchives. |\n| `archive_task` | Archive a task (hide from default views, exclude from capacity, stop syncing). `select_task` restores it. |\n| `show_task_panel` | Show the task panel in the UI. Call when the user asks to see the task list or when you want to display the panel. |\n| `/tasks` (typed by the user, not the model) | The only user command: shows the task stack and drives the workflow card. Every other action is a **sub-verb** invoked by card buttons: `switch` / `archive` / `unbind` / `rename` / `todos …` / `step` / `step-move` / `step-text` for tasks, `insight list [scope] [offset] [limit]` / `confirm` / `promote` / `demote` / `archive` / `restore` / `delete` / `save` / `edit` for memory. |\n| `remember problem solution` | Save an experience note. It is a `kind: 'experience'` insight — same store, same dedup and same delete path as lessons / decisions / procedures. Similar problems merge or overwrite instead of duplicating. |\n| `forget id_or_query` | Delete memories — lessons / decisions / procedures and experience notes alike, across task / project / global in one call, without knowing which layer the entry lives in. An exact id deletes that one entry; keywords match by **query-side coverage** (matched query terms ÷ query terms). Real deletion, no undo; when keywords match more than the cap (default 10) it deletes nothing and only lists the candidates. The **5** most recently deleted entries are kept as full entries in that layer's `deleted.json` next to its store (`<root>/.dsh-project-memory/deleted.json` for the project layer, beside the global file for global), and the deletion result prints that path — read it and save again to recover a mis-delete. |\n| `save_lesson` | Save a lesson / decision / procedure at task, project or global scope; passing `id` **overwrites that entry in place** (only the fields you pass, the previous values stay in `prev` — write them back with the same id). Before writing it compares against existing memory: cosine ≥ 0.9 auto-overwrites that entry, ≥ 0.7 reports the nearest id in the result; without `leanvec` it falls back to lexical overlap ≥ 0.7 merge / 0.65–0.7 reinforce. Two tasks hitting the same insight promote it task → project, three or more → global. Key params: `id`, `title`, `kind`, `scope`, the content (`pattern`/`fix`, `choice`/`reason` or `steps`), and `trigger` (`when` is the only trigger surface, `guard` narrows it, `prevents` records what breaks without it). |\n\n`/tasks` appears in the web `/` menu inside an icon-bearing **Workflow** group, with three view entries — Tasks / Project Memory / Global Memory (labelled in the UI language). A session in one of these runs without memory, with one line on stderr.\n\n**Custom root lists.** The `roots` block overrides that decision. The filesystem root is not eligible.\n- `roots.deny` — this directory cannot be a root, matched exactly; its subdirectories can still be roots of their own.\n- `roots.exclude` — no file in this subtree enters the index, matched by path-boundary prefix (subdirectories included); no new root is inferred inside it either. A complete scan of a parent root skips it and removes entries already indexed under it.\n\n`deny` only decides whether the directory itself can be a root: when a parent is already a root, files under a denied child are still indexed by that parent — use `exclude` (or `.gitignore`, which the git-aware scan already honours) to drop the files too. The lock carries `pid` / `host` / `token`: a live same-host holder is never preempted, release verifies ownership, and a crashed same-host lock is reclaimed immediately. Two dsh instances can share one store. pool.length : limit)\n    // 与经验桶同一顺序：融合 → 逐条闸门 → 截断；先闸后融等于先删掉词法弱但语义近的条目。\n    const scored = matchedFloor(fuseVectorHits(ranked.map((r) => ({ item: r.entry, score: r.score, matched: r.matched })), qs, rerank), qsLayers).slice(0, limit)\n    const top = scored[0]?.score || 1\n    if (scored.length) {\n      buckets.push({\n        layer: 'insight',\n        prior: LAYER_PRIORS.insight,\n        hits: scored.map(({ item, score, vector }) => ({ item, score, vector, prior: LAYER_PRIORS.insight, weightedScore: score, rel: score / top })),\n      })\n    }\n  }\n\n  const flat = buckets\n    .flatMap((b) => b.hits.map((h) => ({ ...h, layer: b.layer, layerPrior: b.prior, hint: h.rel * b.prior })))\n    .sort((a, b) => b.hint - a.hint)\n    .slice(0, limit)\n  return { layers: buckets, flat }\n}\n"
